definitions.explanation: The act of gathering or collecting things together. Used for both systematic gathering of data or materials, and for collecting items as a hobby.

examples.japanese: ⟦{切手|きって}→切手：00718_kitte⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{収集|しゅうしゅう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧{収集|しゅうしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took time to gather information.

examples.english: The city collects garbage every Tuesday.

notes:
A versatile word used across many contexts — from hobby collecting (⟦{切手|きって}→切手：00718_kitte⟧{収集|しゅうしゅう}, stamp collecting) to data gathering (⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧{収集|しゅうしゅう}) to municipal waste collection (⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧{収集|しゅうしゅう}). The person who collects as a hobby is called a ⟦{収集家|しゅうしゅうか}→収集家：16941_shuushuuka⟧ (collector).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧{収集|しゅうしゅう} — information gathering
- ⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧{収集|しゅうしゅう} — data/material collection
- ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧{収集|しゅうしゅう} — garbage collection
- ⟦{収集家|しゅうしゅうか}→収集家：16941_shuushuuka⟧ — collector (hobbyist)
- {収集|しゅうしゅう}{癖|へき} — collecting habit, hoarding tendency
